newsitem.title: USA: Riddell Sports settlement gets court nod.
newsitem.headline: Riddell Sports settlement gets court nod.

text.p: Riddell Sports Inc said on Friday that a bankruptcy court approved the settlement of two fraudulent transfer actions pending against the company.
The court approved a settlement with substantially the same terms as previously reported, Riddell said in a news release.
If there is no appeal, the settlement would take effect in August, the company said.
Riddell on June 4 had announced a settlement that would require it to pay about $2.1 million.
The settlement described on June 4 also required the company to assign up to $3 million of royalities from its "Riddell" footwear licensee over a period of up to 10 years.

Riddell manufactures and reconditions football equipment, provides products and services to cheerleader and dance teams, sells sporting goods and licenses its trademarks for use in athletic footwear and leisure apparel.
